consequence.statement: The build environment now includes ARGOCD_APP_PROJECT_NAME, providing the application project name as an environment variable during builds.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds the ARGOCD_APP_PROJECT_NAME environment variable to the build environment, making the application project name available to build processes.
